description: seed_n = splitmix64(seed + n * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15), all wrapping modulo 2^64. n is a signed 64-bit whole number (it may be negative), given as a signed decimal string in n; before the multiplication it is reinterpreted as an unsigned 64-bit number in two's complement (n + 2^64 when n < 0), given as the object nUnsigned. state is the sum seed + n * gamma mod 2^64, the input to splitmix64, so a port without a native 64-bit integer can check each step. Every 64-bit value is an object: dec (unsigned decimal string), hex (16 lower-case digits, no prefix), hi and lo (its high and low 32 bits as 8 lower-case hex digits).
source: Computed with an independent Python reference written from the format doc and spec 08 only, without reading any Kotlin. Its splitmix64 and fnv1a64 first reproduce every published vector in splitmix64.json and fnv1a64.json.
